caseName: Thies v. Joint Bar Ass'n Grievance Committee for the Second & Eleventh Judicial Districts
caseNameFull: Thies v. Joint Bar Association Grievance Committee for the Second and Eleventh Judicial Districts

opinions.text:
Appeal from Ct. App. N. Y. Motion of New York County Lawyers Assn, for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Brennan and Mr. Justice Powell would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
